title: Otori Emu — Dream Study Session?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't you two sit and rest for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You both saw what Nene said, right?
She should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, but!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We wanna know how her audition went!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Len
rows.Line: Owwy...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that looked like it hurt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You two need to learn to sit still.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But!
Before Nene contacted us, Tsukasa, you were all like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “What's taking her so long...? Did something happen...?” Your brow was all furly-burlied! Am I wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, you can do a better impersonation of me than that. And what do you mean “furly-burlied”...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think she means you had a rather serious look on your face. And I actually liked that impression. It captured the key points rather well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪ Rui praised me☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's great, Emu!
Lemme try... Oh!
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene's here!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late...
I wanted to talk to one of my classmates about something.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's fine! We've been on pins and needles this entire time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that seems like the opposite of fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Len and I literally bumped into each other after pacing around back and forth. But we're both okay now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Umm...
Your eyes look a little red...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was it that obvious...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was talking to my classmate for a while, so I thought they'd have cleared up by now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I need to tell you guys how I did.
That's what you've all been waiting for, after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I failed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really sorry. After you guys gave me all the help you did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I did everything I could to prepare, and gave it my all. That much I know for sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it wasn't good enough.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She seems so frustrated...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, I'd be too... I have to think she practiced lots and lots by herself and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But what do I say in this kind of situation...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I'm gonna work harder than ever before to become a singer and actress who can outdo all her peers.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That includes winning the roles I want to play.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Nene, that was so cooool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? It was?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Your eyes were super sharp and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Super sharp and sparkly indeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, even I understood what she meant just now by super sharp and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, can you guys stop saying that now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep learning more and more!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (In order to make it so Phoenix Wonderland is loved by as many people as the Morinomiya Revue!)
